sample_unit: benchmark datasets (chest radiology report generation, dermoscopy VQA)

links.outcome: Inter-group disparities and overall clinical and language generation performance after bias mitigation fine-tuning
links.effect: FairLLaVA consistently reduced inter-group disparities while improving equity-scaled clinical performance and natural language generation quality across chest radiology and dermoscopy benchmarks (no numbers in abstract).
links.quote: Extensive experiments on large-scale chest radiology report generation and dermoscopy visual question answering benchmarks show that FairLLaVA consistently reduces inter-group disparities while improving both equity-scaled clinical performance and natural language generation quality across diverse medical imaging modalities.

unlisted_practices: Mutual-information-minimizing, parameter-efficient (LoRA) fine-tuning to make multimodal model representations demographic-invariant

screen.reason: The study develops and benchmarks FairLLaVA, a plug-in fairness-aware parameter-efficient fine-tuning method designed as a debiasing safeguard to reduce demographic disparities in clinical MLLM benchmarks (radiology report generation and dermoscopy VQA).
